title: IVC art and craft: added detail

boxes.title: Techniques: more
items: Metal casting continued into **Late Harappan** + Chalcolithic (Daimabad bronzes)
**Seal carving** + **carnelian working**: listed as the period's new techniques
Perforated jar: ==large hole at **base**== + small holes over the wall
Faience used for **beads, bangles**, glazed ware

boxes.title: Toys, beads, shell: more
items: Shell work also at **Lothal**; shell bangles on **Rakhigarhi** burials
